pageInventory.interpretation: The 33 active files are prototype carriers, not a claim of 33 final mini-program routes. G01-G04 are shared state contracts applied only where a matching action exists. V06 remains a redirect to services; V17 remains archive-only.
pageInventory.prototypeEvidenceBoundary: Existing browser checks prove only the recorded synthetic HTML interactions and layouts. They do not prove mini-program runtime, real authorization, cloud, payment, performance, memory, or device acceptance.

rules: Keep first-load failure distinct from true empty and no-filter-match states; retain prior content, filters and position when refresh fails.
For submissions, prevent duplicate actions; on unknown outcome query the same request; preserve user inputs until a definitive result; re-review changed versions.

For images, retain valid inputs after a per-image failure, reject invalid format/size/count according to each field's existing contract, and share public snapshots only with recipient re-authorization.

For exits, deletion and important actions, keep cancellation non-mutating, confirm only permitted objects, and retain consequential outcomes on the original record rather than relying only on a transient toast.
Do not multiply all 24 states across every page. Apply each state only where the source mapping defines a matching action or runtime state.
stateContract.authorityBoundary: Client presentation does not authorize private data or replace server-side permission, money, time, version or status enforcement.

additionalRules: Retain the WeChat capsule and explicitly approved edge-image/layout exceptions.
Mini-program page navigation remains full-screen; child pages hide the TabBar as specified in the SP05 card.
Do not reopen the completed 33-page prototype rollout without a newly confirmed substantive change.

sourceContract.title: 60Hz滚动≥55FPS且无>100ms应用卡顿
sourceContract.precondition: 使用本合同冻结的版本、适用页面/角色/状态及环境；完成对应SP卡前置；真实能力须过其证据门槛
sourceContract.method: 每组3轮，每轮至少30段持续操作片段，冻结段长，使用200条和合法重内容，记录实际刷新率
sourceContract.expected: 每段平均≥55FPS且无>100ms应用可归因卡顿、视觉跳变/错触；高刷和空闲段不替代
sourceContract.evidence: 帧/输入轨迹、长帧明细、每段统计和录屏
sourceContract.failurePolicy: 任何适用预期不满足、缺原始证据或缺关键参数均失败/受阻，不放行；修复后原实例与受影响链路复验
sourceContract.retest: 保留失败输入、版本与证据；同配置重跑失败实例、相关正常/异常/边界及受影响回归
sourceContract.rollback: 按对应SP卡回退说明和前后状态核对；不回滚外部资金事实、不删除历史
